parts.pages: p4 output/supply specs + copper-side pinout, p6 ordering code, p8 input data table, p9 outline
parts.notes: Output rated 24VDC, switching range 1.5-33VDC, max blocking 33V (voltage_rating); peak 50A (10ms); max ON-state voltage drop 0.4V (no on-resistance given); OFF-state leakage 1uA max; min switching current 1mA; rated load DC13 36W. KiCad symbol description says 2A — older Finder datasheets/distributors list 2A, current II-2026 sheet rates 6A (derating curve L34-1 p8). Input is a DC voltage (A1+/A2-), not an LED; Output pins are labelled 13+/14 in the datasheet; KiCad symbol and footprint use 11/14 consistently (polarity: KiCad pin 11 = datasheet 13+).

notes: Footprint OptoDevice:Finder_34.81 checked vs datasheet copper-side view: A2 -3.75mm, A1 0, outputs at 16.25 and 21.25mm (5mm apart), drill 1.3mm, body 28x5mm — matches exactly.
Datasheet pin labels are A1+/A2-/13+/14; KiCad uses A1/A2/11/14. Symbol and footprint agree with each other, so netlisting works; only the output pin number label differs from the datasheet.
KiCad 34.81-9024 description says 2A; current Finder datasheet (II-2026) rates 34.81.7.xxx.9024 at 6A/24VDC. Catalog uses 6A.
RoHS and storage temperature are not stated in the datasheet (it says only 'Cadmium free' for the EMR contacts); left null.
Datasheet gives no on-resistance; max ON-state voltage drop is recorded in notes.
Lifecycle: no per-code status on findernet.com; the 34.81 type is on the current product page and in the II-2026 datasheet, so Active.
AC-output 8240 and 220VDC 7220 types are out of scope and omitted.
